cases.name: Ariel Griffin
cases.about: Her obituary siad, "Ariel attended the public school system in Bronson, Florida during her elementary and middle school years and graduated from Okeechobee High School in Okeechobee, Florida.  Ariel was a mother who took great pleasure in raising her children. She lived for her children.  Ariel loved outdoors and being in nature. She was a full-hearted country girl who was simple and had a fondness for her jeans and and shirts.  Ariel enjoyed going to the beach and she very much liked fishing.  One of her favorite places to go relax was Blue Springs.  Ariel was deeply loved by everyone she came into contact with and has been sadly taken too soon."
